title: The Kitchen by Carl Larsson
content: Two sisters operate the butter churn as the clean dishes are laid out to dry under an open window.Carl LarssonThe Kitchen(1890s), watercolorIn his bookEtt Hem,Carl Larsson says:"The kitchen is the only room in the house that still 'makes sense.' You see, this kitchen is extremely plain but it's clean and arranged pretty attractively for its purpose."
